import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
const {chromium,webkit}=await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const pngModule=await import(process.env.PNG_MODULE); const PNG=pngModule.PNG??pngModule.default.PNG;
const out=process.env.QA_OUTPUT; await fs.mkdir(out,{recursive:true});
const base='http://127.0.0.1:4174',next='http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const routes=['/','/about','/services','/gallery','/blog','/contact'];
const report={checks:[],failures:[],errors:[]};
const homeTargets='.hero__left-card,.hero__right-card,.hero__bottom-card,.hero__insurance,.about__photo--main,.about__photo--secondary,.service-card,.why-choose-us__benefit';
const legacy='[data-about-reveal],[data-services-reveal],[data-gallery-reveal],[data-blog-reveal],[data-contact-reveal]';
const targets=`[data-motion-reveal],${legacy},${homeTargets}`;
async function check(name,fn){try{const detail=await fn();report.checks.push({name,pass:true,detail});console.log('PASS',name);}catch(e){report.failures.push({name,error:e.stack});console.error('FAIL',name,e.message);}}
function track(page){page.on('pageerror',e=>report.errors.push(e.stack));}
async function go(page,url){await page.goto(url,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.locator('main h1').waitFor();await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);}
async function decode(page){await page.evaluate(async()=>{await Promise.all([...document.images].map(async img=>{img.loading='eager';try{await img.decode();}catch{}}));});}
async function sweep(page){
 const count=await page.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').count();
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){await page.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').nth(i).evaluate(el=>el.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'instant'}));await page.waitForTimeout(45);}
 await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
 assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);
 const hidden=await page.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').evaluateAll(es=>es.filter(e=>+getComputedStyle(e).opacity<0.99).map(e=>e.className));assert.deepEqual(hidden,[]);
}
async function staticTimers(page){await page.addInitScript(()=>{const st=window.setTimeout,si=window.setInterval;window.setTimeout=(f,t,...a)=>t>=3000?0:st(f,t,...a);window.setInterval=(f,t,...a)=>t>=3000?0:si(f,t,...a);});}
async function timings(page){return page.evaluate(({targets})=>{
 const time=s=>s.trim().endsWith('ms')?parseFloat(s)/1000:parseFloat(s);
 const list=[...document.querySelectorAll(targets)];
 list.forEach(e=>{if(e.dataset.motionReveal)e.dataset.motionState='visible';else {for(const k of ['about','services','gallery','blog','contact'])if(e.hasAttribute(`data-${k}-reveal`))e.dataset[`${k}RevealState`]='visible';e.classList.add('is-revealed');}});
 return list.map(e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e);const props=s.transitionProperty.split(',').map(s=>s.trim());const dur=s.transitionDuration.split(',').map(time),delay=s.transitionDelay.split(',').map(time);return {cls:e.className.replace(/\s*is-revealed/g,'').trim(),times:props.map((p,i)=>[p,dur[i%dur.length],delay[i%delay.length]])};});
 },{targets});}
for(const [engine,type] of [['chromium',chromium],['webkit',webkit]]){
 const browser=await type.launch();
 for(const width of [390,1440]) for(const route of routes){await check(`${engine} ${route} ${width}: identical settled layout`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width,height:900},reducedMotion:'reduce'});const a=await c.newPage(),b=await c.newPage();track(a);track(b);await staticTimers(a);await staticTimers(b);
  await go(a,base+route);await go(b,next+route);await decode(a);await decode(b);await a.waitForTimeout(100);await b.waitForTimeout(100);
  const x=PNG.sync.read(await a.screenshot({fullPage:true,animations:'disabled'}));const buf=await b.screenshot({fullPage:true,animations:'disabled'});const y=PNG.sync.read(buf);
  const name=route==='/'?'home':route.slice(1);await fs.writeFile(path.join(out,`${engine}-${name}-${width}.png`),buf);
  assert.equal(y.width,x.width);assert.equal(y.height,x.height);
  let diff=0;for(let i=0;i<x.data.length;i+=4)if(!x.data.subarray(i,i+4).equals(y.data.subarray(i,i+4)))diff++;
  await c.close();assert.equal(diff,0,`${diff} pixels differ`);return {pixelsChanged:diff};
 });}
 for(const width of [390,900,1440])for(const route of routes){await check(`${engine} ${route} ${width}: same reveal durations and delays`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width,height:900}});const a=await c.newPage(),b=await c.newPage();track(a);track(b);await staticTimers(a);await staticTimers(b);await go(a,base+route);await go(b,next+route);await a.waitForTimeout(120);await b.waitForTimeout(120);
  const old=await timings(a),current=await timings(b);await c.close();assert.deepEqual(current,old);return {targets:old.length};
 });}
 for(const width of [320,700,701,1100,1101,1920]){await check(`${engine} ${width}: all six pages fit viewport`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width,height:800}});const p=await c.newPage();track(p);
  for(const r of routes){await go(p,next+r);await p.waitForTimeout(80);assert(await p.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1),r);}
  await c.close();
 });}
 for(const route of routes){await check(`${engine} ${route}: natural reveals and no replay`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});const p=await c.newPage();track(p);await staticTimers(p);await go(p,next+route);await sweep(p);
  const states=await p.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.dataset.motionState));assert(states.length>0);
  await p.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await p.evaluate(()=>scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'}));await p.waitForTimeout(500);
  assert.deepEqual(await p.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.dataset.motionState)),states);assert(await p.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1));await c.close();return {targets:states.length};
 });}
 await check(`${engine}: 15% threshold and real intermediate movement`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,next+'/blog');const row=p.locator('.article-row').nth(2);
  await row.evaluate(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();scrollTo({top:scrollY+r.top-innerHeight+r.height*0.1,behavior:'instant'});});await p.waitForTimeout(150);assert.equal(await row.getAttribute('data-motion-state'),'pending');
  await p.evaluate(()=>scrollBy({top:100,behavior:'instant'}));await p.waitForTimeout(100);assert.equal(await row.getAttribute('data-motion-state'),'visible');
  const mid=await row.evaluate(el=>({opacity:+getComputedStyle(el).opacity,transform:getComputedStyle(el).transform}));assert(mid.opacity>0&&mid.opacity<1);assert.notEqual(mid.transform,'none');await p.waitForTimeout(650);assert.equal(await row.evaluate(el=>getComputedStyle(el).opacity),'1');await c.close();return mid;
 });
 await check(`${engine}: gallery filters, Load More, dialog and remembered projects`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,next+'/gallery');await sweep(p);const ids=await p.locator('.project-card').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.dataset.galleryProject));
  for(let i=1;i<await p.locator('.project-gallery__filter').count();i++){await p.locator('.project-gallery__filter').nth(i).click();await p.waitForTimeout(100);assert(await p.locator('.project-card').count()>0);}
  await p.locator('.project-gallery__filter').first().click();await p.waitForTimeout(120);for(const id of ids)assert.notEqual(await p.locator(`[data-gallery-project="${id}"]`).getAttribute('data-motion-state'),'pending');
  await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Load More',exact:true}).click();assert.equal(await p.locator('.project-card').count(),18);await sweep(p);
  const card=p.locator('.project-card__button').last();await card.click();await p.locator('.project-dialog[open]').waitFor();assert.equal(await p.locator('.project-dialog').evaluate(e=>getComputedStyle(e).animationDuration),'0.22s');
  await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Next photo',exact:true}).click();assert((await p.locator('.project-dialog__counter').textContent()).includes('02'));
  await p.keyboard.press('Escape');await p.locator('.project-dialog').waitFor({state:'detached'});assert.equal(await p.locator('.project-card').count(),18);assert.equal(await p.locator('.project-card[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);await c.close();
 });
 await check(`${engine}: blog reader, return focus and Contact context`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:390,height:844}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,next+'/blog');await sweep(p);
  const card=p.locator('.article-row__open').first();const title=await card.textContent();await card.click();await p.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();await p.waitForTimeout(250);
  await p.keyboard.press('Escape');await p.locator('.article-dialog').waitFor({state:'detached'});assert(await card.evaluate(e=>e===document.activeElement));await card.click();await p.locator('.article-dialog__cta').click();await p.locator('#contact-message').waitFor();assert((await p.locator('#contact-message').inputValue()).includes(title.trim()));await c.close();
 });
 await check(`${engine}: Contact immediate form, validation, files and console-only submit`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:390,height:844}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);let logged=0,posts=0;p.on('console',m=>{if(m.text().includes('[Veldridge Contact demo'))logged++;});p.on('request',r=>{if(r.method()==='POST')posts++;});await go(p,next+'/contact#contact-form');
  assert.equal(await p.locator('.inquiry-form [data-motion-reveal]').count(),0);assert(await p.locator('#contact-name').evaluate(e=>e===document.activeElement));await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Send Message',exact:true}).click();assert(await p.locator('[aria-invalid="true"]').count()>0);
  await p.locator('#contact-name').fill('Motion Test');await p.locator('#contact-email').fill('test@example.com');await p.locator('input[type=file]').setInputFiles({name:'roof.png',mimeType:'image/png',buffer:Buffer.from('demo-image')});assert.equal(await p.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(),1);await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Send Message',exact:true}).click();await p.getByText('Demo complete.',{exact:true}).waitFor();assert.equal(logged,1);assert.equal(posts,0);await p.getByRole('button',{name:'Back to Form',exact:true}).click();assert.equal(await p.locator('#contact-name').inputValue(),'Motion Test');assert.equal(await p.locator('.photo-picker__file').count(),1);await c.close();
 });
 await check(`${engine}: reduced motion, missing observer, printing, settings override`,async()=>{
  for(const mode of ['reduce','missing']){const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:390,height:844},reducedMotion:mode==='reduce'?'reduce':'no-preference'});if(mode==='missing')await c.addInitScript(()=>{window.IntersectionObserver=undefined;});const p=await c.newPage();track(p);for(const r of routes){await go(p,next+r);assert.equal(await p.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);}await c.close();}
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,next+'/about');assert(await p.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count()>0);await p.emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'reduce'});await p.waitForTimeout(80);assert.equal(await p.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);await p.emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'no-preference'});assert.equal(await p.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);
  await go(p,next+'/services');await p.evaluate(()=>window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));assert.equal(await p.locator('[data-motion-state="pending"]').count(),0);
  await go(p,next+'/blog');await p.waitForTimeout(120);const duration=await p.evaluate(()=>{document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--motion-reveal-duration','0.73s');return getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.page-hero__content')).transitionDuration;});assert.equal(duration,'0.73s');await c.close();
 });
 await check(`${engine}: anchors, keyboard focus and Home interactions`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}}),p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,next+'/services');const anchors=await p.locator('.service-finder__link').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.getAttribute('href')));for(const href of anchors){await p.locator(`.service-finder__link[href="${href}"]`).click();await p.waitForTimeout(600);assert.equal(await p.locator(`${href} [data-motion-state="pending"]`).count(),0);}
  await go(p,next+'/blog');await p.locator('.article-row__open').last().focus();assert.equal(await p.locator('.article-row').last().getAttribute('data-motion-state'),'static');
  await go(p,next+'/');await sweep(p);await p.locator('.service-card').nth(1).hover();await p.waitForTimeout(800);assert((await p.locator('.service-card').nth(1).evaluate(e=>getComputedStyle(e).transform)).includes('-6'));
  await p.locator('.faq__toggle').first().click();await p.waitForTimeout(450);assert.equal(await p.locator('.faq__item').first().locator('.faq__panel').evaluate(e=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity),'1');
  await p.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});await p.locator('.why-choose-us__benefit').nth(1).click();assert((await p.locator('.why-choose-us__benefit').nth(1).getAttribute('class')).includes('--open'));await p.locator('.header__burger').click();assert.equal(await p.locator('.header__burger').getAttribute('aria-expanded'),'true');await p.keyboard.press('Escape');assert.equal(await p.locator('.header__burger').getAttribute('aria-expanded'),'false');await c.close();
 });
 await check(`${engine}: shared carousel timers and StrictMode navigation`,async()=>{
  const c=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900}});await c.addInitScript(()=>{window.__timers=[];const st=window.setTimeout,si=window.setInterval;window.setTimeout=(f,t,...a)=>{if(t>=3000)window.__timers.push(['timeout',t]);return st(f,t,...a);};window.setInterval=(f,t,...a)=>{if(t>=3000)window.__timers.push(['interval',t]);return si(f,t,...a);};});const p=await c.newPage();track(p);await go(p,'http://127.0.0.1:4193/');await p.waitForTimeout(3500);const timers=await p.evaluate(()=>window.__timers);assert(timers.some(([k,t])=>k==='timeout'&&t===3300));assert(timers.filter(([k,t])=>k==='interval'&&t===5000).length>=2);
  for(const r of routes.slice(1)){await p.locator(`.header__nav-link[href="${r}"]`).click();await p.waitForTimeout(150);assert.equal(await p.locator('.motion-root').count(),1);assert(await p.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').count()>0);}
  await p.locator('.header__nav-link[href="/"]').click();await p.waitForTimeout(250);assert.equal(await p.locator('[data-motion-reveal]').count(),16);await c.close();return {timers};
 });
 await browser.close();
}
report.passed=report.checks.length;report.failed=report.failures.length;await fs.writeFile(path.join(out,'report.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:report.passed,failed:report.failed,errors:report.errors.length}));if(report.failed||report.errors.length)process.exitCode=1;
